title: Credit a German public buyer for a cancelled training day and returned handbooks, as XRechnung and a page
person: The billing clerk of a small training company crediting a district administration against an invoice already sent.
review: The credit note GS-2026-0042 credits one training day at 1.200,00 EUR (19 %) and ten handbooks at 24,50 EUR (7 %) against invoice RE-2026-0311 of 15.09.2026: 1.445,00 EUR plus 245,15 EUR VAT, 1.690,15 EUR.
revised_review: Twelve handbooks are credited instead of ten (294,00 EUR at 7 %), the total is 1.742,58 EUR, and nothing else changed.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
The XML is a credit note, type 381, with its own number, and the page calls itself one.
The credit note names the invoice it amends by number and date, in the XML and on the page.
Every amount and quantity is positive.
One VAT group per rate, each the sum of the credited lines, and totals that add up to the case's figures.
The XRechnung rules hold: the Leitweg-ID as buyer reference, payment instructions, and the seller's contact with name, phone and email.
The page says credit note in its own language and names the invoice it corrects.
The page is laid out on DIN 5008 Form B.
Only the cancelled day and the returned handbooks are credited, at the prices and VAT rates of invoice RE-2026-0311; the two training days that took place and the other handbooks are not.
The revision changes the handbook quantity and the totals that follow from it, and nothing else.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the companies, people, prices and numbers are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
